summary: Ananta Research Lab EXIT LOGIC feature fully verified — web + shared backend. Dialog exposes EXIT LOGIC section (exit-logic-config) on Track A + Track C (hidden on Track B / Fresh, as coded). Sub-options COLLAPSED by default; exit-targets-toggle expands to reveal target-profit-input (default 5) & target-loss-input (default 4). Engine selection disables the inputs; Fixed enables them. Existing DONE run rows render badges 'Fixed $5/$4' and 'Engine exit' via run-exit-<id8>. Expanded fixed run shows detail-exit-method banner ('Exit method used: Fixed $ Target (TP $5 / SL $4)') and tradelog-toggle-<BASE> ('Show full trade log (7)') that expands tradelog-table-<BASE> with all 8 columns (#, Entry time, Exit time, Entry, Exit, Size, P&L $, Exit). First trade P&L row = -4.00 / FIXED_SL — matches spec. Engine run's banner reads 'Universal Exit Engine (ATR-based)'. PDF download OK (11473 bytes). Backend pytest: 4/4 green (fixed run nets ±5/±4 on every non-EOD close, engine label present, runs list surfaces exit_method, PDF 200). Only pre-existing minor: Radix Dialog a11y warning (missing DialogDescription) — carry-over from iter 20.

issues: Toggle text renders as 'Target profit / loss($5 / $4)' — missing a space before the parenthetical value hint. Cosmetic only.
